newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys Sept 1-10 jet fuel at over $191/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys Sept 1-10 jet fuel at over $191/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender 32,000 tonnes of jet fuel at slightly over $191 per tonne for September 1-10 delivery, cost-and-freight Keelung or Shenao, a CPC official said on Friday.
Traders said the sale was made by a Dutch oil trading firm at $191.75 per tonne.
CPC delayed awarding the contract on Thursday as it sought to change the delivery date of the cargo to the second half of September due to high domestic stocks.
But the late delivery dates came with a higher price which CPC was not keen to accept, traders said.
The tender, which closed on July 30, attracted more than 12 offers.
In its last tender for August 1-10 delivery, CPC bought 32,000 tonnes of jet fuel at around $197 per tonne, c-and-f basis.
